about: VSB Engineering College is an autonomous engineering institution offering UG and PG programs across multiple departments, with a focus on academics, placements, and campus development.

admissions.process: Admissions are offered through Government Counseling (TNEA) for Government Quota seats and through direct Management Quota admission for the remaining seats.
admissions.eligibility: Pass in Higher Secondary (10+2) with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics as core subjects, meeting the minimum marks required by the affiliating university/AICTE norms.
admissions.timeline: Management quota counseling typically starts after Class 12 results; TNEA counseling follows the Anna University schedule announced each year.

departments.name: Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
departments.overview: Focuses on software development, algorithms, AI/ML, and systems.
departments.vision: To produce globally competent computer science professionals.

departments.name: Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) (CCE)
departments.overview: Specializes in network security, ethical hacking, and secure systems design.
departments.vision: To create skilled cybersecurity professionals for evolving digital threats.

departments.name: Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
departments.overview: Covers communication systems, embedded systems, VLSI, and signal processing.

departments.name: Mechanical Engineering (MECH)
departments.overview: Covers thermal, design, manufacturing, and automation engineering.

departments.name: Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE)
departments.overview: Covers power systems, control systems, and electrical machines.

departments.name: Civil Engineering (CIVIL)
departments.overview: Covers structural, geotechnical, and construction engineering.

courses.duration: UG: 4 years (8 semesters). PG: 2 years (4 semesters).
courses.intake: Varies by department, typically 60-120 seats per UG program.

placements.training: Includes aptitude training, technical training, mock interviews, and soft-skills sessions coordinated by the placement cell.

scholarships.eligibility: Based on academic merit, family income criteria, and government scholarship scheme norms.
scholarships.tuitionWaiver: Available for eligible first-graduate/merit students as per management policy.

facilities.library: Central library with technical journals, e-books, and a digital library section.
facilities.hostel: Separate hostel blocks for boys and girls with mess facilities.
facilities.transport: College buses covering major routes around the campus.
facilities.sports: Indoor and outdoor sports facilities including a playground and gym.
facilities.labs: Department-specific labs plus a central computing/research lab.
facilities.medical: On-campus first-aid/medical room with tie-up hospitals for emergencies.

faqs.a: We offer UG programs in CSE, CSE (Cyber Security), ECE, EEE, MECH, and CIVIL, along with PG programs including M.E. CSE, M.E. Structural Engineering, and MBA.
Our placement cell conducts regular training and drives with recruiters such as TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant, Zoho, and HCL. See the Placements page for the latest figures.
